sentences.en: Saturday is the pottery class I've been attending since last year.
sentences.zh: 周六是我去年开始上的陶艺课。

sentences.en: Pottery usually appears in a culture after the advent of agriculture.
sentences.zh: 陶器通常在农业出现之后出现在一种文化中。

sentences.en: Clay is the essential ingredient in making pottery.
sentences.zh: 黏土是制作陶器的关键成分。

phrases.zh: 陶艺课：上陶艺课的班级或课程

senses.zh: 陶器；陶土，黏土；制陶，陶艺；陶瓷厂；陶瓷之都（斯塔福德郡特伦特河畔斯托克市周边地区，为英国陶瓷工业基地）（the Potteries）
